name: Hideaki Arakawa
source: Hideaki can be seen as a "problem student" at school, and not many people want to be around him. He is quite proud of his status as a troublemaker but sometimes wishes that people take him more seriously. Although he is known for his bad behavior, he can have a heart of gold and really cares about the well being of his friends. He works at the nearby beef bowl restaurant.
